Tomato Late Blight.description: This is a fungal disease. It is recommended to apply a copper-based fungicide and ensure proper air circulation around the plants.

Potato Early Blight.description: This fungal disease can be managed by applying fungicides containing mancozeb or chlorothalonil. Remove and destroy infected leaves.

Tomato Bacterial Spot.description: This is a bacterial infection. Use copper-based bactericides for treatment. Avoid working with plants when they are wet.

Healthy.description: The plant appears to be healthy. Maintain good watering, fertilization, and pest control practices to keep it that way.
